_readme: Prompt list for models.mjs, from the KontorRPG Meshy Prompt Style Guide (works for Tripo and Meshy). prompt = subject + category extra + style. Tripo also gets the negative prompt (max 255 characters). Edit freely.
style: stylized low-poly game asset, chunky simple shapes, slightly oversized head hands and feet, clean flat-shaded faces, hand-painted flat colour texture with light speckle, muted Nordic palette, no baked lighting, readable silhouette, single object, centered, plain background
negative: photorealistic, realistic skin, fine detail, noise, thin parts, loose cloth, hair strands, glossy, metallic shine, baked shadows, text, logo, multiple objects, pedestal, ground plane, gore

tripoAnimations._note: Logical animation names used in categories → Tripo presets (max 5 per model). Biped presets: idle, walk, run, dive, climb, jump, slash, shoot, hurt, fall, turn.

races._note: Matches packages/shared/src/character.ts RACES (human 1.85 m, dwarf 1.3 m, gnome 0.95 m).

helmets.extra: single helmet only, empty, no head, no face

shoulders.extra: single shoulder piece only, no body, no arm

weapons.extra: single weapon only, no hands, light neutral grey metal

weapon-fish.extra: single object only, no hands, no stand
